adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: Jobs::PollFeed builds `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and passes it to `TopicEmbed.import` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `raw_html` (app/models/post.rb). The embed UI renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), so any HTML/JS in the feed item content will be stored and rendered without sanitization, enabling stored XSS if the configured feed can be influenced.
